title: 8 משחקים וספרים לגילאי 3-5 שיעזרו להם לעשות דברים בעצמם

stage.need: Doing things on their own: dressing, trying, deciding and checking by themselves. HealthyChildren lists at 3 to 4 years 'Dresses and undresses self (coat, jacket, shirt)' and at 4 to 5 years 'Dresses and undresses without assistance', 'Brushes teeth' and 'Shows more independence'; KidsHealth lists 'be a helper' at about 4 years and advises letting kids try new things and know they are capable of doing new things. Games with a built-in self-check and stories about trying give an opportunity to practise; not a guarantee.
stage.age_caveat: Ages are approximate: these are milestones that many children reach by an age, not deadlines. Some 4 year olds dress alone and some need help for a long time. The frame says בסביבות and the caption says יש ילדים ש.... Three products have no printed age (our reading, flagged in each one's limitations) and two games are officially from 5 or 4 (חיות במשבצות from 5, הרמז צעיר from 4).

dev_sources.title: Developmental Milestones: 4 to 5 Year Olds
dev_sources.publisher: HealthyChildren.org, American Academy of Pediatrics (last updated 4 Apr 2023)
dev_sources.quote: Can count 10 or more objects ... Dresses and undresses without assistance ... Brushes teeth ... Shows more independence and may even visit a next-door neighbor by self
dev_sources.supports: At 4 to 5 years the cognitive milestones include counting 10 or more objects, and the hand and social milestones include dressing and undressing without assistance, brushing teeth and showing more independence. Milestones are a general idea, not a deadline.

dev_sources.title: Developmental Milestones: 3 to 4 Year Olds
dev_sources.publisher: HealthyChildren.org, American Academy of Pediatrics (last updated 4 Apr 2023)
dev_sources.quote: Understands the concept of counting and may know a few numbers ... Dresses and undresses self (coat, jacket, shirt) ... Eats independently
dev_sources.supports: At 3 to 4 years the cognitive milestones include understanding the concept of counting and maybe knowing a few numbers, and the social milestones include dressing and undressing self and eating independently. Milestones are a general idea, not a deadline: the page says development can take a slightly different course.

dev_sources.title: Your Child's Development: 4 Years (Milestones)
dev_sources.publisher: Nemours KidsHealth (medically reviewed July 2025, Larissa Hirsch, MD)
dev_sources.quote: count to at least 10 ... be a helper (for example, pick up toys) ... Kids this age like to move and try new activities. Encourage development by letting kids try new things. ... Help kids build confidence in this area and foster their self-esteem by letting them know they are important and capable of doing new things.
dev_sources.supports: By about 4 years children may count to at least 10 and be a helper, and the page advises letting kids try new things and letting them know they are capable of doing new things. 'Usually do by this age' is a range: the page says some children gain skills earlier or later.

notes: Slot 5 of the 2026-10-18 weekly batch, second of two carousels (format mixed2). Draw: 8 suggestions (3 games, 4 books and the LumeBook book). Order B G B G B G L B. Different age range (3 to 5, the first carousel is 3 to 4) and no product shared with the first carousel or with other slots. Evidence read on 2026-10-16: Sifriyat Pijama pages (Noah the Chick, Where's My Tiger?), Center Toys popularity-sort positions (חיות במשבצות 111 and הרמז צעיר 60 of 1663), Kodkod and Steimatzky product pages. Four products are popular_in_israel (two Sifriyat Pijama picks, two Center Toys top 10 percent); three are available_in_israel only, so the carousel is not publish-ready. The ages of היכון להמראה and הילדה שנסתה are not printed (our reading), and הרמז צעיר is 4-5 at Kodkod but 5-8 at Center Toys.
